ModDescription: Groundcover with grass. iOS textures-only bundle: the two Classic-style billboard textures the port's forced configuration loads, and nothing else. The mod's C# is compiled into the app (Assets/Scripts/Game/Mobile/Ports/RealGrass), so this manifest ships no scripts, no meshes, no materials and none of the project-scoped VMblast textures. Upstream declared DFUnity_Version 0.15.3; this bundle is built for and verified against 1.1.1.
